1. (Currently amended) A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member, __wherein said plurality of fins and said plurality of light emitting diodes are arranged in an alternating pattern around the columnar body__.

2. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein a second end of said columnar body is open __and said columnar body is comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK__.

5. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said diodes are substantially evenly spaced radially around the columnar body __and said fins are positioned between adjacent diodes__.

6. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said fins are substantially equally disposed between said diodes __and said fins and diodes form a repeating alternating pattern around the circumference of the columnar body__.

7. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body comprises one of a tetragon, pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, octagon, nonagon, decagon, hendecagon, or dodecagon in cross-section __and each face of the columnar body has at least one light emitting diode mounted thereon__.

8. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 7 wherein at least one diode resides on each face of said columnar body __and one fin resides on each corner of said columnar body__.

9. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 8 wherein one fin resides on each corner of said columnar body __and a single diode resides on each face__.

10. (Cancelled)

11. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body and said fins are comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK __and said material is selected from copper or aluminum alloys__.

13. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said base member comprises an Edison screw base or a wedge base __and is configured to mate with a standard lamp socket__.

16. (Currently amended) A lamp comprising an elongated hollow polygonal body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, a fin extending radially from each corner of said body, a light emitting diode mounted to each side of said body, a screw or wedge base connector closing a first end of said body, a second end of said body being open, an electronics module disposed within said body in electrical communication with said connector and said light emitting diodes, said lamp having a general A19 outline, __wherein the fins and diodes are arranged in an alternating pattern around the body__.

17. (Currently amended) A method of manufacturing a lamp comprising extruding an elongated hollow body, said body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, cutting said body to a predetermined length, attaching at least one light emitting diode to said body, providing electrical circuitry suitable for powering said light emitting diode, __and arranging said diodes and integral radially extending fins in an alternating pattern around the body__.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said material has a thermal conductivity greater than about 150 W/mK __and is selected from aluminum alloys__.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said body includes a plurality of integral radially extending fins __positioned between adjacent light emitting diodes__.

20. (Cancelled)

3. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 further including a light dispersing optic element overlapping said diodes __wherein said optic element is individually positioned over each diode__.

4. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element includes a phosphor material __and is configured to convert light wavelengths emitted by the diodes__.

12. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 9 including a single optic element disposed between each adjacent fin overlapping said diode __wherein each optic element is individually configured to direct light from its corresponding diode__.

15. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element preferentially directs light substantially perpendicular to an elongated axis of the columnar body __and is shaped to provide a specific light distribution pattern__.

14. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said electronics module comprises a printed circuit board including circuitry for converting AC to DC current __and further includes a dimming control circuit__.
